level_id_bank.verdict: NOT HELD. The name reads as two ladders that keep nearly agreeing, and the operator painted the places where they do: a band across both 3.115 rungs (254.54/261.03) and another across P-4.115 and Q-4.618 (314.28/319.52), with the 12M high just above the upper one. He drew exactly one thing that belongs to neither ladder -- a brown box at 265-273 over the recent bars. The structural spine is 194.80, where the two ladders agree to 0.02. Between the painted lower band and the 213-225 shelf there is a 13.2% void with no rung of either ladder in it, which is the single most tradeable feature of the map.
